speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Level one hundred. Forty-five hundred meters. This is Apex Bastion, fortress of the Praetorian Guard.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Level one hundred. Forty-five hundred meters. This is Apex Bastion, fortress of the Praetorian Guard.

speaker: TITAN
text: Three meters of obsidian alloy. Plasma guns covering the courtyard. They have turned the summit into a killing ground.
subtitle: TITAN: Three meters of obsidian alloy. Plasma guns covering the courtyard. They have turned the summit into a killing ground.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: The clouds are below us. Ice on the parapets, crosswinds over the rail. Stay away from those edges.
subtitle: OCEANUS: The clouds are below us. Ice on the parapets, crosswinds over the rail. Stay away from those edges.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Heavy signatures ahead. Praetorian shock troops and cyber-samurai. The Commander's personal guard. They know we are here.
subtitle: MIRAGE: Heavy signatures ahead. Praetorian shock troops and cyber-samurai. The Commander's personal guard. They know we are here.

speaker: AURA
text: Their comms are silent. No panic. They know the Nexus is gone, and they mean to hold this wall anyway.
subtitle: AURA: Their comms are silent. No panic. They know the Nexus is gone, and they mean to hold this wall anyway.

speaker: SURYA
text: The stairway leads to the throne room. Artillery at the perimeter gate. We will need every operative to break through.
subtitle: SURYA: The stairway leads to the throne room. Artillery at the perimeter gate. We will need every operative to break through.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Colossal war chassis at the gatehouse. Bastion Praetor. The last mechanized guardian between us and the Commander.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Colossal war chassis at the gatehouse. Bastion Praetor. The last mechanized guardian between us and the Commander.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: We broke the registry, emptied the Grave, and brought their sky-shields down. We are not stopping at the front door.
subtitle: MIRAGE: We broke the registry, emptied the Grave, and brought their sky-shields down. We are not stopping at the front door.

speaker: KAITO
text: Through the Guard, through the Praetor, and on to the throne. Axiom Force, blades drawn. Breach the Bastion.
subtitle: KAITO: Through the Guard, through the Praetor, and on to the throne. Axiom Force, blades drawn. Breach the Bastion.
